title: Routing protocol hardening batch (Failover, PIM, PIM6, Static ARP)
acceptance_criteria: `/routing/static-failover/failover` provides form-driven failover route CRUD without free-form command entry.
`/routing/multicast/pim` provides form-driven CRUD for global settings, interface settings, RP mappings, and IGMP joins.
`/routing/multicast/pim6` provides form-driven CRUD for interface MLD settings and static MLD joins.
`/routing/infrastructure/arp` provides form-driven static ARP CRUD with interface selection and MAC validation.
Validation passes: frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
assumptions: Existing protocol wrapper endpoints remain sufficient for these UI slices with no backend API contract changes.
Interface selectors use merged discovery from ethernet config + show physical + show all interfaces for resilience.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Replaced command-box workflow with structured failover route editor and diff-based save generation.
Implemented guide-aligned PIM/PIM6 form editors with interface-aware selectors and nested join handling.
Implemented dedicated static ARP form editor with MAC-format validation and diff-based save behavior.
Validated with frontend tsc/lint/build plus runtime and browser smoke checks.
Manual in-session review completed; no blocking issues found.
